title: Accessible Toggle Switch
prompt:
Implement a React + Tailwind toggle switch component. Requirements:
- Controlled component (`checked`, `onChange`)
- Fully keyboard accessible (Space/Enter to toggle, Tab to focus)
- aria-checked and proper role
- Smooth thumb transition
- Disabled state with reduced opacity
expected: A function component using button[role=switch] with aria-checked, focus ring, transition classes, and disabled handling.

title: Stale Closure in useEffect
expected: Stale closure: the effect captures `count` at mount. Fix by including `count` in deps, or using a ref, or functional setState pattern.

title: Debounced Async Search Hook
prompt:
Implement a TypeScript hook `useAsyncSearch<T>(fn: (q: string) => Promise<T[]>, delay = 300)` that:
- Debounces input by `delay` ms
- Cancels in-flight requests when input changes
- Returns `{ query, setQuery, results, loading, error }`
- Handles unmount safely (no setState after unmount)
expected: Hook using AbortController + setTimeout cleanup + isMounted ref pattern.

title: API Reference: rate-limit middleware
prompt: Write API reference documentation for a Node.js middleware `rateLimit({ windowMs, max, keyGenerator? })`. Include: overview, signature, parameter table, behavior on limit exceeded (HTTP 429 + Retry-After), and a usage example with Express.
expected: Sections: Overview, Signature, Parameters table, Response, Example.

title: Prompt Injection in a RAG endpoint
expected: Identifies: untrusted question concatenated into system context; untrusted docs may contain injected instructions; no input length cap; no output filtering. Mitigations: structured messages, instruction hierarchy, content filtering, output validation.
